content.title: Will there be an XO, Kitty season 4?
content.text: **Warning: XO, Kitty season 3 spoilers ahead.** Kitty Song-Covey has grown up a lot since we first met her as Lara-Jean's meddling little sister in the To All the Boys... movies.And in XO, Kitty season 3, she finally gets a love story moment of her own. Just in time too – as she's now halfway through her final year at the Korean Independent School of Seoul (KISS), and things are far more complicated than she could have ever imagined.Throughout the latest episodes, Kitty was on a mission to complete her Sunset List: a collection of "perfect" final year things to do before her time in Korea is over and she heads back to the States.Among her hopes is cementing her relationship with Min Ho. They've been a little unbalanced, to say the least. It goes from bad to worse when a miscommunication makes Kitty thinks Min Ho has got schoolmate Eunice pregnant.But just when she's ready to give up, he delivers the perfect romcom declaration of love: a song written about her AND a last-minute rush through the airport.But will we get to see her get her fairytale ending as she graduates? Here's everything you need to know about what lies ahead for Kitty and her KISS pals.Will XO, Kitty return for season 4?Currently there is no news on whether XO, Kitty will return for a fourth season.In some ways, Kitty has her fairytale ending, flying business class into the sunset with Min Ho back home.But then again, there is still some time left at KISS before she graduates, so there's definitely room for a return!Lara-Jean made an appearance to look after her little sister in XO, Kitty season 3. Youngsol Park/Netflix © 2026Who could star in a potential XO, Kitty season 4?XO, Kitty just wouldn't work without the lead star – so actress Anna Cathcart will certainly return if the show is given the go-ahead.Sang Heon Lee, who plays Kitty's beau Min Ho Moon will also be a certainty to return.At the end of the season, Min Ho ran to join Kitty at the airport, with the pair flying off to her hometown of Portland, Oregon for the school break.As a result, it's also likely we could see other faces from Kitty's past in the To All The Boys series as Min Ho meets the family.This includes her dad Dan (played by John Corbett), her stepmother Trina (Sarayu Blue), and the biggest test of all: her beloved sisters Margot (Janel Parrish) and Lara-Jean (Lana Condor). When could a potential XO, Kitty season 4 be released?Min Ho and Kitty. Courtesy of Netflix © 2026While there's currently no confirmation that XO, Kitty will return – if it does, it's likely to be sooner rather than later.The first season was released in 2023, while seasons two and three came out in quick succession, dropping in 2025 and 2026.So if it continues its current speed, we could potentially see the KISS gang back on our screens in 2027.We will update as we know more!XO, Kitty is available to stream on Netflix now.
